title: Sherpa UI Element Node
description: A single, self-contained element description for dynamic/generative content. Children and named-slot fills are INLINE element nodes (no id registry — that is the view-definition's job). `type` is a literal custom-element tag and `props` are literal attribute names. `data` is the element's populate() payload. This is the composable unit consumed by renderElement().

type.description: The literal custom-element tag to create, e.g. 'sherpa-metric'. Custom elements always contain a hyphen.

props.description: Literal attributes. Keys are attribute names (data-* for the public API; native attrs un-prefixed). Values: string|number → setAttribute(String(v)); true → boolean (empty) attribute; false|null → attribute omitted.

data.description: The element's populate() payload. Passed to el.populate() once rendered. An array (1-D collection), a keyed collection object ({rows,columns} / {steps} / …), a precompiled HTML string, or a { src } remote reference (fetched then populated).

oneOf.description: A keyed collection or single record bound by the component.

slots.description: Named-slot fills: slot name → an inline element node (or an array of nodes for multi-fill). Regions this element exposes for a parent to fill — distinct from `children`, which is default-slot content.

children.description: Ordered inline element nodes placed in this element's DEFAULT slot.

src.description: URL to fetch as JSON, then hand to el.populate(). Equivalent to authoring data-src-json.
